findings.title: World Series Game 1 home side contradicts its own venue
findings.detail: The row for MLB World Series Game 1 lists home=Tampa Bay Rays and away=Milwaukee Brewers while its venue field is American Family Field, Milwaukee — the Brewers are the home club in Game 1 of the official schedule.

findings.title: World Series Game 3 sides are inverted the same way
findings.detail: Game 3 is listed with home=Milwaukee Brewers while the venue is Tropicana Field, St. Petersburg, where Tampa Bay are the home club.
